mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, status, address, contact, phone, create_time FROM warehouse ORDER BY id
SELECT id, code, name, status, address, contact, phone, create_time FROM warehouse WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, code, name, status, address, contact, phone, create_time FROM warehouse WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse (code, name, status, address, contact, phone) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{status}, #{address}, #{contact}, #{phone})
